title: Sofirn H35B Rechargeable LED Headlamp with Red Light US$11.99 + US$3.99 Delivery (~A$22.39) @ Sofirn
body:
Deal: Sofirn H35B Rechargeable LED Headlamp with Red Light US$11.99 + US$3.99 Delivery (~A$22.39) @ Sofirn

[alvian] A reminder to include an expiry date in your deal posts whenever possible. In this instance, a countdown timer is clearly displayed in your flash sale promotional banner. You can find the edit button on the submenu located between the deal title and your user name.
[rumblytangara] Thanks, that worked for a completely different product as well
[compound] Good light but heats up hard with the white LED. I use the red light a lot for beekeeping.
[bogak] Very long is all I can say. I was painting walls with it on medium setting all day and it didn't go flat.
[drup] Did they fix the usb c being a pain in the arse to plug in?
[bogak] Never had an issue with mine. You are not good at plugging things in maybe?
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] I think they refer to the part you have to screw out, to reveal the port.
it's not like it's hard to unscrew though and only requires couple turns. maybe they are just used to always accessible usb-c port. I heard technically it's fine because usb-c port itself is meant to be water resistant <- don't quote me it's just what a couple sources said when I searched for it.
but obviously if port is hidden the water resistance is even better.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] I have the H35R version of this and it has been such a great reliable headlamp.
I don't know the exact differences but I think the R is more neutral 5K white, and the red mode is very bright might be the differences.
it's been awhile since I posted the deal on the R so can't remember but I think the most upvoted opinion was you can go straight to red mode from off without cycling through white. also it remembers the brightness in both red and white mode. very user friendly and has been reliable using it about a year+ now.
[Elusive8985] Description of this product:
Please note: red light can only be activated after turning on the white light in the current version.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] ok that's another important difference then.
so people that value good Red mode and straight to red (I don't use it but apparently good for camping) should buy the R instead.
[sol3x] How's the delivery timeframe like if ordered directly from Sofirn?
[sol3x] This exact same model? May I know how the battery life is like ?
[ShortyX] Another option - https://www.sofirnlight.com/products/sofirn-hs10-mini-headla…
[R3XNebular] HS10 is a great light, just dies to quickly when fishing after a few hours. Keen to try this one as supposedly will last longer. Or I just take both :)
[gccmelb] I know it isn't the same head lamp, In mid August I got the H25LR LED for US $5.80 from Aliexpress. Please note I used coins and discount code(s).
Having a look when I at the coin page, it comes down to US $9.90 with free shipping. Might be less with a code.
https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005003989468484.html
[dufflover] Was just about to say this. I've gotten my couple of Sofirn lights from AliExpress with big coin discounts (I've seen it vary day to day even within the same sale period). Stack with the usual coupons and 20%-ish TCB and shopping credit it works out noticeable cheaper.
[montorola] Appreciate you saying this mate, forgot about using coins on Ali!
Ended up getting the Sofirn SP40A for around $20AUD with coins.
[Sephanite] How long was delivery time purchasing from Sofirn?
[Tr0jan] What's the benefit of this headlamp over other similarly priced options with higher lumens, such as this?
https://www.amazon.com.au/Blukar-Rechargeable-Floodlight-Com…
[DannyBoy] Absolutely no chance that is putting out 2000 lumens..
And more ironically it looks similar to the Temu style headlamps branded 'Shark'. It might just be the shell but still I paid about $5
[wt860] It's US$5.7 delivered in China. Can't imagine how they manufacture it
